Hullo day crew,
Thanks for a calm watch; the front-desk agent raised a concern about noise levels

I wanted to circle back with a quick reminder to keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk voice low and steady across the counter, especially when the waiting area gets busy. Passengers and pets settle better when our handoffs feel unhurried, and that tone helps the boarding flow stay smooth for everyone. Please keep the welcome team looped in early so they can guide travelers before the line starts to bunch up.

For the arrival pickup path, <<FACT F107>>. Once that step is clear, we can keep the rest of the handoff tidy and reduce extra back-and-forth at the desk. If someone from the front desk flags a concern again, please acknowledge it right away and keep the conversation brief, calm, and friendly.

For boarding, <<FACT F087>>. That requirement should stay part of our standard check so the traveler experience remains consistent from the first greeting to the final handoff. Thanks for staying attentive to both the paperwork and the tone of the room, because both matter when families are already a bit on edge and just want a smooth send-off.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
